families.name: Wayside Shrine
families.desc: A small shrine by an old path. Someone still remembered it, once.

families.name: Old Lantern Road
families.desc: Copper lantern posts mark a road nobody walks any more.

families.name: Collapsed Dwelling
families.desc: A home, long abandoned. The hearth is cold.

families.name: Abandoned Mining Camp
families.desc: Rails, a cold fire, and work left half done.

families.name: Cairn Circle
families.desc: Stacked stones in a ring around a carved sign.

families.name: Broken Bridge
families.desc: Half a bridge, reaching for a far side that fell long ago.

families.name: Fallen Colossus Head
families.desc: A stone face as tall as a house, lying where it fell.

families.name: Old Well
families.desc: A well shaft with a rotten windlass. Water glints far below.

families.name: Watch Post
families.desc: A sheltered post where someone once kept watch.

families.name: Grave Garden
families.desc: Quiet stones among flowers. Someone was loved here.

families.name: Potters' Kiln
families.desc: A brick kiln and the pots it never finished firing.

families.name: Waystone
families.desc: A carved marker stone. Its carvings count distances in lamps.

families.name: Abandoned Hamlet
families.desc: A row of empty houses. They left in a hurry, or not at all.

families.name: League Waystation
families.desc: A rest-house of the old lantern roads, with a pump outside.

families.name: Cold Forge
families.desc: A smithy whose great hearth has been dark for an age.

families.name: Tide Shrine
families.desc: Sea-green pillars around an altar that still glows.

families.name: Seed Terraces
families.desc: Ringed garden terraces, still growing on their own.

families.name: Star Dial
families.desc: A ring of carved stones around a pointer that aims at the ceiling.

families.name: Overgrown Hall
families.desc: A great hall that a mushroom has slowly claimed.

families.name: Frozen Hermitage
families.desc: A hermit's house, half swallowed by ice.

families.name: Stilt Houses
families.desc: Platforms on tall posts above the wet ground. One has fallen.

families.name: Lightning Tower
families.desc: A tower crowned with copper, built to call the sparks down.

families.name: Old Quarry
families.desc: Terraced cuts in the rock and a crane that still stands.

families.name: Silent Ruins
families.desc: Broken columns furred with a strange growth. The air feels listened to.

families.name: Vault Gatehouse
families.desc: Twin towers guard a gate into nothing. What did it keep out, or in?

families.name: Aqueduct
families.desc: Arches carry a channel across the cavern. Water still runs in places.

families.name: Lost Market
families.desc: Empty stalls around a dry fountain. It must have been loud, once.

families.name: Great Library
families.desc: Shelves upon shelves. Most books are dust, not all.

families.name: Amphitheatre
families.desc: Tiered stone seats facing an empty stage. Your footsteps carry.

families.name: Ruined Foundry
families.desc: Furnaces, rails and chimneys. This was a place of work.

families.name: The Seated Colossus
families.desc: A giant carved from the rock sits with its hands on its knees, watching.

families.name: The Great Stair
families.desc: A stair wide enough for a crowd climbs to a landing above the cavern.

families.name: The High Bridge
families.desc: A slender arch leaps between two pillars, high above the floor.

families.name: Lantern Spire
families.desc: A copper tower, its lamp still burning. You can see it from far away.

families.name: The Root Arch
families.desc: A root as thick as a house rises out of the ground and dives back in.

families.name: Crystal Cathedral
families.desc: Spires of living crystal hum around a pale nave.

families.name: Frozen Falls
families.desc: A waterfall stopped mid-fall, blue and silent.

families.name: Ember Caldera
families.desc: Black monoliths stand around a glowing pool.

families.name: Sunken Dome
families.desc: A great dome of sea-glass, half drowned.

families.name: Giants' Ring
families.desc: Giant mushrooms stand in a perfect circle around a glowing lawn.

families.name: The Stone Titan
families.desc: A tree turned to stone, older than any forest.

families.name: The Great Orrery
families.desc: Rings within rings, frozen mid-turn around a starstone heart.

families.name: Storm Pylons
families.desc: Three pylons strung with copper hum before every flash.

families.name: Hanging Gardens
families.desc: Terraced gardens step upward, water spilling from each.

families.name: Field of Obelisks
families.desc: Leaning stones carved with the same six signs.

families.name: The Silent Bell
families.desc: A bell the size of a house hangs over an altar. It has not rung for a long time.

families.name: Sealed Cellar
families.desc: A ruined house with a cellar door that stuck. Something below is shut tight.

families.name: Smugglers' Den
families.desc: A hidden cave-mouth with boot-worn steps going down.

families.name: Drowned Crypt
families.desc: A crypt whose stairs go down into still water.

families.name: Kiln Vault
families.desc: Heat rises from a kiln's mouth that leads down, not in.

families.name: Spore Warren
families.desc: Tunnels under a mushroom, breathing spores.

families.name: Frost Cistern
families.desc: An ice-rimmed stair into a cistern that breathes cold.

families.name: Echo Vault
families.desc: A stair under a stone ring. Sounds come back changed.

families.name: Lantern Works
families.desc: A League workshop with a lift shaft into the dark.

families.name: Warden Barracks
families.desc: A walled barracks. The gong in the yard is still hung.

families.name: Tide Temple
families.desc: A pillared temple whose lower halls lie under water.

families.name: Seed Vault
families.desc: A domed hatch in a garden. Under it, a vault.

families.name: Observatory
families.desc: A domed tower with a telescope aimed at the stone sky.

families.name: Stormworks
families.desc: A generator hall over a deep pit. Something here once made lightning.

families.name: Ossuary
families.desc: A chapel whose stair leads to the bones of the old dead.

families.name: The Sealed Vault
families.desc: A gate court with statues and a stair into the deep. The great door below is shut.

families.name: Drowned Archive
families.desc: A ring of stone above a flooded stair. Shelves sway below the water.

families.name: Deep Foundry
families.desc: A foundry whose works go far below the floor, still warm.

families.name: Singing Hall
families.desc: A stair into crystal. The air hums in chords.

families.name: The Heartwood
families.desc: The greatest root of all goes down into the floor, and so does a stair.

families.name: Silent Sanctum
families.desc: A court of black pillars at the edge of the deep. Nothing makes a sound here.

families.name: Hidden Grotto
families.desc: A dry room behind falling water.

families.name: Hollow Pillar
families.desc: A stone column, hollow all the way up.

families.name: Buried Reliquary
families.desc: Under the cairn, a room of offerings.

families.name: Hermit's Cell
families.desc: Someone lived inside the rock itself.

families.name: Fungal Heart
families.desc: Under the great mushroom, the roots make a room.

families.name: Ember Shrine
families.desc: A shrine behind a seam of fire.

families.name: Star Window
families.desc: A room under a floor of stars.

families.name: Drowned Bell
families.desc: Something rings beneath still water.

families.name: Root Hollow
families.desc: A hollow inside a living root.

families.name: Geode Heart
families.desc: A crystal egg the size of a room.

families.name: Thunder Hollow
families.desc: Hoof-scarred roots and a smell of wet earth. Something heavy beds down here.

families.name: The Spore Grove
families.desc: Pale caps the size of houses, and the air is thick enough to taste.

families.name: The Drowned Choir
families.desc: A temple of nacre, half under water. Someone still keeps watch.

families.name: The Frozen Howl
families.desc: A ring of cold braziers around a frozen lake, and tracks everywhere.

families.name: The Pylon Yard
families.desc: Copper pylons stand around a sleeping shape that hums.

families.name: The Ash Pit
families.desc: Basalt broken from below; the ground is warm and restless.

families.name: The Hall of Lanterns
families.desc: Old League lantern posts, still lit, though nobody has tended them for an age.

families.name: The Singing Vault
families.desc: Crystal grows here in chords. Your footsteps ring.

families.name: The Island Ring
families.desc: Stone islands over black water. The water is too still.

families.name: The Silent Cathedral
families.desc: Pillars, bells that make no sound, and a hush that presses on your ears.

families.name: The Heartwood Chamber
families.desc: The oldest root you have ever seen, and it is breathing.

families.name: The Seam Chamber
families.desc: High under the roof of the world the stone hums like a struck bell.

families.name: The Heart Engine
families.desc: A sealed hall at the bottom of everything. The walls are warm, and they beat.

secrets.name: The Well's Hidden Tunnel
secrets.desc: Someone dug sideways at the bottom of the well.

secrets.name: The Hidden Cellar
secrets.desc: Under the floor, the family kept what mattered most.

secrets.name: The Smith's Strongbox
secrets.desc: Bricked in beneath the anvil.

secrets.name: The Pearl Grotto
secrets.desc: A secret room under the shrine.

secrets.name: The Hidden Armory
secrets.desc: Behind a false wall, the garrison's spare gear.

secrets.name: The Inner Channel
secrets.desc: Inside the pier, a maintenance shaft.

secrets.name: The Secret Stacks
secrets.desc: The books they did not want borrowed.

secrets.name: The Colossus' Heart
secrets.desc: A chamber in the giant's chest.

secrets.name: The Landing Door
secrets.desc: At the top of the stair, a room waited for those who could read the signs.

secrets.name: The Titan's Crown
secrets.desc: High in the stone tree, a hidden floor.

secrets.name: The Orrery's Core
secrets.desc: Inside the starstone heart.

secrets.name: Beneath the Bell
secrets.desc: A chamber under the altar.

secrets.name: The Ice Tomb
secrets.desc: Behind the frozen fall.

secrets.name: The Lamp Vault
secrets.desc: Where the League kept its best lamps.

secrets.name: The Observers' Crypt
secrets.desc: Under the telescope floor.

secrets.name: The Reliquary
secrets.desc: Behind the bones.

secrets.name: The Vault Archive
secrets.desc: The record of the vault, kept apart.

secrets.name: The Hidden Grotto
secrets.desc: A dry room behind falling water.

secrets.name: The Hollow Pillar
secrets.desc: A stone column, hollow all the way up.

secrets.name: The Buried Reliquary
secrets.desc: Under the cairn, a room of offerings.

secrets.name: The Hermit's Cell
secrets.desc: Someone lived inside the rock itself.

secrets.desc: Under the great mushroom, the roots make a room.

secrets.desc: A shrine behind a seam of fire.

secrets.name: The Star Window
secrets.desc: A room under a floor of stars.

secrets.name: The Drowned Bell
secrets.desc: Something rings beneath still water.

secrets.desc: A hollow inside a living root.

secrets.desc: A crystal egg the size of a room.

records.title: Carved Lintel
records.voice: a carving in the six signs
records.text: WHAT IS SEALED IS KEPT. WHAT IS KEPT IS NOT LOST.

records.title: Carved Plinth
records.voice: a carving in the six signs
records.text: Six signs to open, six to close. Spiral, eye, wave, flame, star, key.

records.title: Worn Relief
records.voice: a carving in the six signs
records.text: We closed the sky so the deep could breathe. Do not open what we closed.

records.title: Step Inscription
records.voice: a carving in the six signs
records.text: Count the steps. Each was cut by a hand that knew why.

records.title: Door Frame
records.voice: a carving in the six signs
records.text: The door listens. Speak to it in signs, not in force.

records.title: Cracked Tablet
records.voice: a carving in the six signs
records.text: When the engines falter, the light goes from the stone. Wait. It returns.

records.title: Road Marker
records.text: Waystation: 6 lamps north. Water at the pump. Lamp oil: none. Sorry.

records.title: Road Marker
records.text: THIS ROAD KEPT BY THE LEAGUE. Leave the posts lit for the next walker.

records.title: Road Marker
records.text: Old vault 11 lamps east. CLOSED BY ORDER. Do not reopen.

records.title: Scratched Plate
records.text: Lamps dark again. Third time this season. Walk in pairs.

records.title: Road Marker
records.text: From here the crystal country. Lamps burn brighter. Mind your eyes.

records.title: Shell Carving
records.text: The water remembers every voice. Sing softly, so it remembers you kindly.

records.title: Shell Carving
records.text: Here we gave the shrine to the water, so it would never be forgotten.

records.title: Shell Carving
records.text: The old ones went down into the deep water and did not come back. We sing for them.

records.title: Shell Carving
records.text: Offer what the water gives you, and it will give again.

records.title: Oath Plate
records.text: KEEP THE FIRES LIT. SEVEN LINKS, ONE CHAIN, NO BREAK.

records.title: Oath Plate
records.text: When the forge goes dark, the world goes cold. So we were told. So we tell.

records.title: Oath Plate
records.text: The first smiths found these fires already burning. We have only fed them.

records.title: Oath Plate
records.text: Light the hearths in the order of the tally, or not at all.

records.title: Garden Stone
records.text: Every seed is a door. Plant it, and wait for it to open.

records.title: Garden Stone
records.text: These seeds came down from the great tree. Keep them dry and keep them dark.

records.title: Garden Stone
records.text: We buried our dead with seeds in their hands, so they would have something to do.

records.title: Garden Stone
records.text: A winter without seasons came. The gardens slept. They will wake.

records.title: Star Notation
records.text: The ceiling is a lens. Behind it, the true sky. We have measured its stars.

records.title: Star Notation
records.text: Point the eye at the brightest stone and wait for it to move. (It has not moved.)

records.title: Star Notation
records.text: Light bends. Turn the mirrors and the light will go where you ask.

records.title: Star Notation
records.text: The lens clouded in the year of the Dimming. We kept counting anyway.

records.title: Silent Marks
records.text: Below us it sleeps. Above us they forget. Between, we keep quiet.

records.title: Silent Marks
records.text: Put out every flame. In the dark, the signs will show the way.

records.title: Silent Marks
records.text: Not yet. Not yet. Not yet.

records.title: Lamplighter's Journal
records.voice: Oda, lamplighter of the eastern road
records.text: Day 41. The lamps went dark again between the third and fourth posts. I walked it with a hand on the wall. Something breathed in the dark, or I did.

records.title: Lamplighter's Journal
records.voice: Oda, lamplighter of the eastern road
records.text: The Guild says the luminite is failing because we opened the old vaults. I say the luminite is failing and we opened the vaults. Not the same thing.

records.title: Waystation Ledger
records.text: Lamp oil: 0. Bread: 4 loaves. Travellers this week: 2. Travellers last week: 11. If no one comes by the turn of the month I will close the station.

records.title: Unsent Letter
records.text: I will come home when the road is lit again. Tell mother the crystal country is beautiful. Do not tell her about the dark.

records.title: Guild Order
records.text: By order of the council, the vault at the end of the eleventh road is to be sealed and its records burned. The council regrets the deaths.

records.title: Vault Record
records.text: Cycle 9. The engines hum lower. We have closed the outer doors. The sleepers are counted: all present.

records.title: Vault Record
records.text: To whoever opens this: we are not gone. We are waiting. Do not wake us without reason.

records.title: Builder's Note
records.text: The colossus took four generations. The face is my grandmother's. Nobody else knows that, and now you do.

records.title: Drowned Hymn
records.text: Water over stone, water over bone, carry us home. Water over gate, water over grate, we will wait.

records.title: Note in a Bottle
records.text: They are flooding the temple tomorrow. I hid my pearl in the grotto under the altar. If you find it, it was mine.

records.title: Furnace Log
records.text: The deep furnace burns without fuel. I have fed it nothing for a week. It burns. I asked the elders why. They told me to keep feeding it.

records.title: Complaint
records.text: Seven links, one chain. Seven hearths, no rest. When I asked what would happen if a hearth went out, they made me tend it alone for a month.

records.title: Seed Almanac
records.text: Ancient seed: plant on mineral ground. Patience. Patience. More patience. It will fruit. It always fruits.

records.title: Letter to a Daughter
records.text: I planted the terraces in rings so you could find your way to the middle with your eyes closed. Count the rings. You'll find me there.

records.title: Observation Log
records.text: Night 3,112 (by our count, there are no nights). The bright stone in the north ceiling has dimmed by a hair. We recorded it. No one cares.

records.title: Observation Log
records.text: Mirror test: the beam reached the receiver on the fourth try. The lens is not a lens. It is a lock. Do not tell the others yet.

records.title: Clay Tablet
records.voice: no name, only a pressed handprint
records.text: We learned to walk without sound. We learned to speak without sound. It still dreams. We are the quiet around its dreams.

records.title: Hermit's Diary
records.text: Third winter alone. The ice sings at night. I have stopped answering it.

records.title: Crumpled Note
records.text: Hoist needs the right weight or the gate won't lift. Count the notches. Don't be greedy, it tips.

records.title: Explorer's Page
records.voice: an explorer who did not sign
records.text: Food for three days, light for two. If you read this, I went on without enough light. Bring more than you think.

records.title: Explorer's Page
records.voice: an explorer who did not sign
records.text: Rule one: the seals don't break. Don't waste your pick. Rule two: everything else does.

records.title: Explorer's Page
records.voice: an explorer who did not sign
records.text: The plates that look worn are worn for a reason. Step around them, or jam them with a stick.

records.title: Scholar's Letter
records.voice: a scholar of a later age
records.text: Every people down here tells the story differently. The Vaultwrights fled, or slept, or became fire, or water, or seeds. Perhaps they are all right.

rumors.text: There's an old {name} out there, {where}. Nobody goes. You might.
My grandmother used to talk about a {name}, {where}. I never went.
If you go {where}, you'll see something. Can't miss it. A {name}. Take a friend, it's a long way.
Folk say there's a {name} {where}. Folk also say don't go there. I'd listen to the second part.
A trader told me about a {name}, {where}. He said it was shut. He also said he heard it breathing.
The scholars won't say it aloud, but I've seen the old maps. There's something called the {name}, {where}. Go prepared.
Old places? Down here everything's old. But nothing I'd send you to, not near here.
Not round here. Try asking a cartographer, or walking further than sensible people do.
Beyond the roots, {where}, there's a {name}. The leaves grow funny around it.
The elders say the ribs of the sky come down somewhere {where}. Look for a {name}.
There's a {name} {where}. My uncle went in. He came out quieter.
There's a cold forge, or what's left of one, {where}. A {name}. Shameful, letting a fire die.
The oath says keep the fires lit. Whoever built the {name} {where} kept them lit underground. Strange people.
The water remembers a {name}, {where}. Sing as you walk, it helps.
They say the old ones went into the deep water. There's a {name}, {where}. Bring air.
The spores remember a {name}, {where}. Breathe slow there.
If you want to see something that sings, go {where}. A {name}.
Good stone in the {name}, {where}. Shame about whoever left it.
There's an old {name}, {where}, with gardens nobody tends. They're growing anyway.
The ceiling lies, you know. Go {where} and look at the {name}, and tell me I'm wrong.
The {name}, {where}. The old observers left their best work behind a door that only answers light.
...keep the lamps lit...
...count the signs...
...not yet...
...the water remembers...
...we are only waiting...
...walk in pairs...
...put out the flames...

encounters.desc: A wall sloughs off and bares ore.
Fungi release spores and new caps grow.
